candidates.name: OS legacy control data
verified_facts: Ordnance Survey labels passive stations, benchmarks and triangulation stations as legacy control data.
The legacy search tools expose archive control information that is no longer maintained.
semantic_limits: Legacy-control availability cannot be treated as current parcel terrain evidence or as a replacement for maintained OS Net control and validated DTM lineage.

candidates.name: Search for passive stations
verified_facts: OS describes an archive of about 900 Passive GPS stations across Great Britain.
The stated standard error of the passive network is 0.055m in plan and 0.066m in ellipsoidal height at 95% confidence.
semantic_limits: Passive-station archive accuracy is not a parcel ground-height measurement and cannot replace current GNSS control, antenna processing, geoid transformation or DTM sampling evidence.
